subject.title: Suppress model fallback notices in rooms

question: Should fallback activation and recovery notices remain visible in direct chats while being suppressed only in group/channel rooms, or should every external messaging surface suppress them?
rationale: Current documentation intentionally makes these notices visible, while the canonical report asks for external-channel suppression and this PR selects a narrower room-only policy; code inspection cannot establish the permanent product boundary.

options.title: Room-only suppression
options.body: Keep direct-chat diagnostics visible, suppress them in group and channel rooms, and preserve lifecycle events by gating only notice payload construction.

options.title: All external suppression
options.body: Treat fallback notices as internal telemetry on every external messaging channel while retaining status, logs, and lifecycle diagnostics.

options.title: Keep current visibility
options.body: Retain visible fallback notices on all reply surfaces and close this proposal if operator observability outweighs shared-room disclosure concerns.

recommendation.title: Room-only suppression
recommendation.body: Keep direct-chat diagnostics visible, suppress them in group and channel rooms, and preserve lifecycle events by gating only notice payload construction.

likelyOwner.reason: The fallback observability contract appears to originate in their merged feature work, making them the strongest available owner for calibrating its visibility boundary.
